finding_summary: is_empty estimator on exact=false systematically under-counts by ~35% across all collection sizes (10/50/100/200). exact=true correctly counts MISSING+NULL fields, but exact=false appears to count only MISSING fields (or uses incorrect formula). Consistent ratio across sizes indicates systematic estimator bug, not random approximation noise.

defect_details.systematic_bias_pattern: exact=false returns ~65% of exact=true count consistently
defect_details.root_cause_hypothesis: is_empty estimator counts only MISSING fields but ignores NULL values, or applies incorrect divisor in estimation formula

test_methodology.data_distribution: 33% MISSING field, 33% NULL value, 34% with value
test_methodology.control_validation: scroll ground truth matches exact=true (MISSING+NULL count)
test_methodology.index_configuration: keyword index on 'city' field to trigger approximate path
test_methodology.significance_threshold: >20% deviation across all sizes = systematic bug
